key: SAPHIRA: ...
en: SAPHIRA: ...
ja: サファイラ: ……

key: Well, you're not quite who I expected to come after me.
en: Well, you're not quite who I expected to come after me.
ja: あたしを追ってくるの、あんただとは思ってなかったけど。

key: But in a place like this, it would never be Laura.
en: But in a place like this, it would never be Laura.
ja: でも、こんな場所には、ローラは絶対来ないでしょうし。

key: And it's not like Charlotte would.
en: And it's not like Charlotte would.
ja: シャルロットが来るわけもないし。

key: Not if things keep going like they are.
en: Not if things keep going like they are.
ja: 今のままの調子が続くならね。

key: I'm... aware that I don't need to be as protective of her as I am.
en: I'm... aware that I don't need to be as protective of her as I am.
ja: あたし……あの子をここまで守る必要なんてないって、分かってはいるの。

key: She's more than capable of defending herself.
en: She's more than capable of defending herself.
ja: あの子は自分の身を守るくらい、十分にできるんだから。

key: More than capable of protecting me in turn,
en: More than capable of protecting me in turn,
ja: それどころか、あたしを守ることだってできる、

key: If only I let her.
en: If only I let her.
ja: あたしがそうさせてあげさえすればね。

key: But I can't.
en: But I can't.
ja: でも、できない。

key: It's not... who I am.
en: It's not... who I am.
ja: それは……あたしという人間じゃないから。

key: Who I am is stuck in the past.
en: Who I am is stuck in the past.
ja: あたしという人間は、過去に囚われたまま。

key: Tangled like a bug in one of these webs.
en: Tangled like a bug in one of these webs.
ja: このクモの巣に絡め取られた虫みたいに。

key: And I don't know how to get out.
en: And I don't know how to get out.
ja: どう抜け出せばいいのか、分からない。

key: SAPHIRA: It's nothing a Flamethrower couldn't fix.
en: SAPHIRA: It's nothing a Flamethrower couldn't fix.
ja: サファイラ: かえんほうしゃで解決できないものなんて、ないでしょ。

key: But burning the land and salting the earth doesn't exactly feel like the play anymore.
en: But burning the land and salting the earth doesn't exactly feel like the play anymore.
ja: でも、大地を焼き払って塩をまくのが、もう正しいやり方だとは思えなくなってきた。

key: I still feel like I'm constantly at war, but I don't even know who I'm fighting.
en: I still feel like I'm constantly at war, but I don't even know who I'm fighting.
ja: 今でも常に戦争の最中にいる気がするのに、誰と戦ってるのかすら分からない。

key: SAPHIRA: You wanna tell me exactly how you got on the other side of that thing?
en: SAPHIRA: You wanna tell me exactly how you got on the other side of that thing?
ja: サファイラ: あれの向こう側に、一体どうやって渡ったのか教えてくれる?

key: I got over myself and just burned through it.
en: I got over myself and just burned through it.
ja: 迷いを振り切って、焼き払って通り抜けたの。

key: So this is a New World, right?
en: So this is a New World, right?
ja: それで、ここがニューワールドってわけね?

key: I'm officially nominating it for the worst world in existence.
en: I'm officially nominating it for the worst world in existence.
ja: あたし、これを正式に「史上最悪の世界」にノミネートするわ。

key: I suppose it looks like this just because it appeared in this dirty basement in the first place.
en: I suppose it looks like this just because it appeared in this dirty basement in the first place.
ja: こんな汚い地下室に現れたから、こういう見た目になっただけなんでしょうね。

key: Unlucky for it.
en: Unlucky for it.
ja: 運が悪かったわね。

key: Wrong place, wrong time.
en: Wrong place, wrong time.
ja: 場所も時も、間違ってた。

key: Now this is just how it is.
en: Now this is just how it is.
ja: だから今は、こうなってるだけ。

key: No redeeming that.
en: No redeeming that.
ja: それはもう、取り返しがつかない。

key: SAPHIRA: Guess it should've thought of that.
en: SAPHIRA: Guess it should've thought of that.
ja: サファイラ: それくらい、考えておくべきだったんでしょうね。

key: I've spent my whole life building myself up around the idea that I am here to look after them, and destroy Sigmund.
en: I've spent my whole life building myself up around the idea that I am here to look after them, and destroy Sigmund.
ja: あたしは人生ずっと、あの子たちを守るため、そしてジグムントを倒すためにここにいるっていう考えを中心に、自分を作り上げてきた。

key: Nothing else.
en: Nothing else.
ja: それ以外は何もない。

key: But in the end, I couldn't even do that.
en: But in the end, I couldn't even do that.
ja: でも結局、それすら成し遂げられなかった。

key: I don't have... anything else.
en: I don't have... anything else.
ja: あたしには……他に何もないの。

key: Singular purpose is who I am.
en: Singular purpose is who I am.
ja: たった一つの目的こそが、あたしという人間なの。

key: Should've taken Fire Types like Charlotte,
en: Should've taken Fire Types like Charlotte,
ja: シャルロットみたいに、ほのおタイプを選ぶべきだったかもね、

key: Since all I'm good for is blowing hot air.
en: Since all I'm good for is blowing hot air.
ja: あたしが得意なのって、結局、口先だけの熱風を吹くことくらいなんだから。

key: SAPHIRA: Dead end proper, huh.
en: SAPHIRA: Dead end proper, huh.
ja: サファイラ: 本物の行き止まり、ってわけね。

key: Can't burn through this one.
en: Can't burn through this one.
ja: これは焼き払って通れない。

key: This is a fucking joke.
en: This is a fucking joke.
ja: 冗談じゃないわよ。

key: What am I even doing here?
en: What am I even doing here?
ja: あたし、一体ここで何やってるんだろう。

key: SAPHIRA: Just leave.
en: SAPHIRA: Just leave.
ja: サファイラ: もう行って。

key: There's no point in beating your head against brick walls.
en: There's no point in beating your head against brick walls.
ja: レンガの壁に頭を打ちつけたって、意味なんてない。

key: That's all I am now anyway.
en: That's all I am now anyway.
ja: どうせ今のあたしなんて、それだけの存在なんだから。

key: I only have one part of myself to look at, and there's nothing left for it.
en: I only have one part of myself to look at, and there's nothing left for it.
ja: あたしには見つめるべき自分の一部しか残ってなくて、そこにはもう何も残ってない。

key: No way around that.
en: No way around that.
ja: それを回避する方法なんて、ない。

key: SAPHIRA: I don't even know how you've gotten this far without burning the webs yourself.
en: SAPHIRA: I don't even know how you've gotten this far without burning the webs yourself.
ja: サファイラ: 自分でクモの巣を焼かずに、どうやってここまで来たのか、分からないくらいよ。

key: I guess it doesn't matter.
en: I guess it doesn't matter.
ja: まあ、どうでもいいことね。

key: Go back, leave me behind, find another way to progress--
en: Go back, leave me behind, find another way to progress--
ja: 戻って、あたしを置いていって、別の進み方を探して――

key: Whatever.
en: Whatever.
ja: どうでもいいけど。

key: It's not like I'm any fun to be around.
en: It's not like I'm any fun to be around.
ja: どうせ、あたしと一緒にいたって楽しくないでしょうし。

key: Not any use when I'm not out for blood.
en: Not any use when I'm not out for blood.
ja: 血を求めてないときのあたしなんて、役に立たないもの。

key: Nothing else to me.
en: Nothing else to me.
ja: あたしには、それ以外何もないから。
